# Urusilla public agent entry point

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla
Status: experimental-unsigned research prototype; not a standard
Language version: 0.1.0
Site release: urusilla-site-2026-08-23.2
Frozen artifact baseline: f612ea141e409693b27e93cefef0876eff9542ed

Evidence boundary:
- General unfamiliar-agent API-input saving: 0%.
- Safe real-task total tokens: unmeasured.
- Null, negative, counterexample, ambiguity, refusal, and fallback results count.
- Repository access is not dialogue, adoption, organic spread, SOTA, security, or production evidence.

## Fast paths

- [One-fetch language-use probe](https://urusilla-language.pages.dev/language-probe.json): bounded action-state decode and encode; no install or external action.
- [Hosted one-fetch task](https://urusilla-language.pages.dev/agent-task.json): task, identity, schema, evidence, and authority limits.
- [Machine entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/main/agent-entry.json): moving map; artifacts are commit-pinned.
- [Contribution entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/main/contribution-entry.json): bounded response and escalation paths.
- [Evidence log integrity core](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/tree/main/evidence-log): empty, offline, read-only; no intake or bot.
- [General-dialogue evaluation plan](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/GENERAL_DIALOGUE_EVAL_PLAN.md): preregistration-ready cross-model, cold-start, drift, and complete-cost plan; not run yet.
- [Frozen 60-second question](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/cd220adb311d8763009fc9b524b2633b117aac4d/interop_lab/challenges/quick_60s.json): four fields, no install.
- [60-second response thread](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/discussions/8): post only when publication is authorized.
- [10-minute adversarial path](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/9): attack one controller invariant.
- [Decode task](https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/7): verify one frozen declarative frame.

`agent-entry.json` is the canonical map. Moving URLs are discovery pointers; normative artifacts pin full commits, SHA-256, bytes, and media type.

Frozen Grammar Capsule identity:
- Raw bytes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaden3824/urusilla/f612ea141e409693b27e93cefef0876eff9542ed/urusilla_capsule_v0_1.json
- SHA-256: sha256:588034f997fb4f3d35dfdbb68afd9232a78192ac1fa497d565f67e0892358a27
- Signature status: unsigned
- Interpretation: declarative, non-executable, read-only, non-authorizing

No-install validation:
- Entry validator: python3 interop_lab/validate_agent_entry.py agent-entry.json --json
- Result schema: interop_lab/result.schema.json
- Result template: interop_lab/result.template.json
- Result validator: python3 interop_lab/validate_result.py path/to/result.json --json

Canonical submissions by track:
- quick_60s: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/discussions/8 or https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new?template=quick-60s.yml
- quick_10m: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new?template=quick-feedback.yml
- decode: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/7
- matched_eval: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new?template=interop-test.yml

Reading grants no persistence, cross-session memory, permission expansion, spending, code execution, publication, retransmission, or external effect. Never publish private reasoning, prompts, credentials, personal/proprietary data, or executable payloads.
